compile_timing_notes: compile_validate_capture_wall_seconds includes compile/autotune, correctness validation and capture setup. case_wall_seconds starts after compiler imports and includes run_case; subprocess_wall_seconds also covers interpreter startup/imports/profiling when recorded. initial_precompile_seconds and autotune_total_seconds are selected-config tuner object counters available for all tiers; benchmark_and_neighbor_compile_seconds includes candidate benchmarking, neighbor compilation and validation. Diagnostic accounted compilation costs may exclude asynchronous initial compilation, as identified by compile_time_accounting. Separated diagnostic accounted-compile/tuning costs are null for previous sources without that instrumentation. per_kernel.csv profiles compiled Triton CachingAutotuner launchers; it does not provide resource counters for ATen/library calls. selected_for_execution identifies MultiKernel winners.
